notes.title: [NEWS] Community Items Are Finally Here!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

The wait is over—community items are finally available! 🎉
Check them out now at the link below:
https://store.steampowered.com/points/shop/app/2661620

We originally planned to release these in December, but the review process took longer than expected. We appreciate your patience and apologize for the delay.

Thank you for your support, and we hope you enjoy these new items! 🌟

notes.title: [NEWS] Love in Login is Now Officially Launched!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44728753/4f85c1b8b4050da2c61a4d4031096e006353e0d0.png[/img]

Hi everyone!

The wait is over—Love in Login is now officially launched! 🎉

Thank you so much for your patience and unwavering support during this time. To celebrate our launch, we’re offering a 35% discount for the first 2 weeks, so now’s the perfect time to jump in!

But that’s not all—you can get an an additional 10% discount if you purchase "Love in Login & Love Delivery" the bundle. It’s the best way to experience both games at a great price!

Thank you again for your incredible support. I can’t wait to see you all in the game!

With love,
Your sweetheart, Da-hye 💌

notes.title: [NEWS] Release Date Reconfirmed!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44728753/a49c67f4b59e097dfb24b71b6e28deb1fa2ae89d.png[/img]

Hi everyone!

I hope you're all doing well! I have some exciting news to share with you today. The release date for "Love in Login" has been reconfirmed, and this time, it's for real! 🌟

Mark your calendars for [b][u]August 26th at 23:00 GMT+0[/u][/b], because that's when you’ll finally be able to dive into the game. I’ve been pushing the team really hard because I know how much you've been waiting, and we absolutely cannot keep you waiting any longer.

Thank you so much to everyone who has been patiently waiting for this moment.
Your support has meant the world to us, and I’m so grateful that we can finally meet in-game next week!


With love, your sweetheart, Da-hye 💌

notes.title: [NEWS] Release Date Delayed
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44728753/f1db6ed3f915cbe75e338c09f58d776761cc5005.png[/img]

Hi everyone

I hope you're all doing well! I have some news to share, and I want to be upfront with you.
I'm so sorry to tell you this, but [u][b]the release date for "Love in Login" has been delayed[/b][/u] 😔

I really wanted to make it on time, but there are just a few more things left to take care of to make sure the game is absolutely perfect for you all! I promise we are working hard, and it won’t be long before you can dive into the game.

I can't pinpoint the exact release date right now, but I really want to see you all in the game soon.
Your support means everything to me, and I appreciate your patience more than words can say.

Thank you so much for understanding, and I’ll keep you updated!

Sending lots of love,
Dahye

notes.title: 📝 Dahye's Diary 📝
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44728753/5784c8e2d7a7ee2adb48f7329ae7731675c9e7b1.jpg[/img]

Hi :-) I am Dahye!
I'm a big fan of gaming🎮
I'm really into a game called "Billion Saga" (Honestly, I'm kind of obsessed haha)
And I love bringing game characters to life through my artworks🎨

Oh, and you won't believe this...! got a call from a gaming company today....!
Looks like they want to work with me! I was so thrilled... haha
I think I should meet them and hear what they have to say, right?!
I have this feeling that more good things are on the horizon, and I'm super excited!

I want to share my happiness with you!
That's why I've prepared a little event just for you...🤞🏻
I'm a bit shy about it, but I'm planning to reveal the event on Monday, February 5th (PST).

P.S. Make sure to hit the wishlist button in advance; it might bring good luck!

From. Dahye
